name: Augmedix
description: Augmedix is an enterprise medical documentation platform acquired by Commure in 2024 for its hybrid human+AI scribe capabilities. Two products: Augmedix Go (AI-only, $200-400/provider/month estimated) for lower-complexity specialties, and Augmedix Live ($400-700+/provider/month estimated) combining AI with remote human scribes for ED, hospitalist, and complex care. Used by 30,000+ providers including HCA Healthcare, Dignity Health, and MultiCare. Key differentiator: only major platform offering true human QA oversight with 98%+ accuracy. HITRUST certified—rare in the AI scribe space. Not for solo practitioners or budget-conscious practices; enterprise contracts typical with pilot programs for evaluation.
short_description: Enterprise hybrid human+AI scribe by Commure. Augmedix Go (AI-only) and Live (human QA). $200-700+/mo. HITRUST certified. 30,000+ providers.
one_liner: Enterprise hybrid human+AI scribe. 98%+ accuracy. HITRUST certified. $200-700+/mo.

tiers.name: Augmedix Go (AI-Only)
tiers.description: Fully automated ambient AI documentation for lower-complexity specialties. Real-time transcription, EHR integration, mobile app. No human oversight.

tiers.name: Augmedix Live (Hybrid)
tiers.description: AI-powered documentation with remote human scribe QA review. 98%+ accuracy. Real-time support for ED, hospitalist, complex care. Deep EHR integration.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.description: Health system-wide deployment. Per-encounter pricing available. Volume discounts. Dedicated implementation support.

pricing.notes: Pricing significantly higher than AI-only competitors due to human scribe component. Enterprise contracts typical. Pilot programs available for health systems to evaluate before committing. Per-encounter pricing now offered in addition to per-clinician models.

compliance.security_note: HITRUST certified—rare among AI scribe vendors. SOC 2 Type II compliant. Enterprise-grade security for health systems.

ambient_ai.description: Augmedix Go provides fully automated ambient documentation for in-person and telehealth visits.

hybrid_model.description: Augmedix Live combines AI with remote human scribes for 98%+ accuracy. Only major vendor offering true human QA.

accuracy.description: Live model achieves 98%+ accuracy with human oversight. Go model achieves 90%+ AI-only.

best_for: Health systems wanting the only hybrid human+AI option with 98%+ accuracy
ED and hospitalist programs requiring maximum documentation accuracy
Organizations using Epic, Cerner, or athenahealth with deep integration needs
Practices that tried AI-only scribes and need human oversight for complex cases
Enterprises already using Commure products (acquired parent company)
not_for: Budget-conscious small practices—Freed ($39-119/mo) or Commure Scribe ($59-89/mo) cheaper
Mental health therapists—Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) purpose-built for therapy
Psychiatrists needing medication management—consider Freed or mdhub
Organizations wanting quick self-service setup—Augmedix requires implementation

faqs.q: How much does Augmedix cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Augmedix Go (AI-only) costs approximately $200-400/provider/month. Augmedix Live (hybrid human+AI) costs $400-700+/provider/month. Enterprise contracts with volume discounts available. Per-encounter pricing now offered as alternative to per-clinician model.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Augmedix Go and Augmedix Live?
faqs.a: Augmedix Go is fully automated AI documentation for lower-complexity specialties (90%+ accuracy). Augmedix Live combines AI with remote human scribe QA review for 98%+ accuracy—ideal for ED, hospitalist, and complex care where errors are costly.

Yes. Commure acquired Augmedix in 2024, adding hybrid human+AI capabilities to their portfolio alongside Commure Scribe ($59-89/mo AI-only). Augmedix maintains its brand and enterprise focus within the Commure family.

faqs.q: Is Augmedix good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: No. Augmedix is enterprise-focused on primary care, ED, and hospitalist. Mental health therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo) or mdhub (contact for pricing).

faqs.q: Augmedix vs DAX Copilot: which is better?
faqs.a: Both are enterprise-grade. Augmedix offers unique hybrid human+AI option (Live) for 98%+ accuracy when human oversight matters. DAX Copilot is pure AI with tighter Microsoft/Epic integration. Augmedix has HITRUST certification; both have SOC 2. Choose Augmedix for human QA, DAX for deeper Epic workflow integration.
